title: SEAF MC Cobblemon
description: The Official Cobblemon Modpack for the SEAF MC Minecraft Server.
body:
## General Info
This pack exists to allow players access to SEAF MC’s Cobblemon gamemode. 
While it is possible to use this pack for other purposes, it has been specifically tuned for use on the SEAF MC Minecraft server. ~~For transparency we also publish our server pack which can be found [here](https://modrinth.com/modpack/seaf-mc-cobblemon-server).~~ Coming Soon

## The Focus
This pack is focused on a performance friendly cobblemon experience. Our primary goal is to maintain the classic sandbox feel with the addition of many cobblemon focused features. As such you will not see any built-in quests or similar mechanics.

## Updates
New versions are uploaded on request of the community. Whether it be to update an existing mod or add somthing new. We do our best to follow SemVer: MC updates #.0.0, additions and bigger updates 0.#.0, patches and smaller updates 0.0.#. Changelogs reflect modifications on both the client and server packs.

## Credits
1. Based on the [Fabulously Optimized](https://download.fo/) modpack.
2. Thank you to the amazing developers of the included mods, especially [Cobbled Studios](https://modrinth.com/organization/cobbled-studios).
3. Developed and maintained by the SEAF MC server staff.
